correctness.rationale: Every depth-d forward equality profile is either a unique (transient t, cycle c) first repeat with t+c≤d, or nonrepeat. To have all maximal t=d−c profiles, each c requires a disjoint c-cycle component of at least d vertices. Exactly d² vertices cannot realize nonrepeat; d²+1 is attainable by extending exactly one of the d mandatory tails. The extremal isomorphism classes and automorphism factors are checked. Standard exponential structures SET(CYC(TREE)) give the G_d−B_d exact EGF with B_d excluding nonrepeat. Square-root singularity at e^-1 gives the displayed fixed-d constant. verify.py independently computes rational series and enumerates all endofunctions n≤6 at d≤3 and tests 66 extremal constructions, returning VERIFY_OK 84. Quantifiers, finite exception d=1 and asymptotic fixed-d boundary examined; finite evidence does not substitute for proof.
